tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures match the archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to estimate and distinguish its coupled parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot rows do not adequately identify its five coupled parameters; the archived mechanism specifies at least eight rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled memory model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient and coupled-transient signatures jointly favor the coupled model, but the pilot alone cannot reliably distinguish them.
It does not resolve the coupled-model identifiability problem.
